method.description: Source-pinned static AI research plus one separate-context claim/source review. All validation is documentation/metadata-only.
method.integrity: SHA-1 of b'blob '+decimal_byte_length+b'\0'+raw_bytes equals Git blob SHA; byte length equals fixed tree size.
method.semantic_reading: 1-based inclusive actual read_ranges, separate from byte collection; JSON field projections do not imply full-file semantic reading.
method.publication: private repository research branch and review PR only; no automatic merge

claims.statement: LocalJev is a generated-probability protocol bridge, not Jev model internals or a direct-logit reader.
Current OpenJev has direct MLX reads alongside vLLM extensions; the cited vLLM PR is merged, not proof of released support.
LM Studio issues remained open at collection; reports do not establish universal current runner incompatibility.
index/config/types/server/engine compose the Bun decision service; package declares 0.2.0.
Request shapes, choice 2-128, score 2-10, optional instructions/noul criteria and extra-field handling.
Four aliases use one upstream model; only two are listed and success reports localjev-0.2; not full TypeSafe behavior parity.
Fixed strict json_schema, internal q IDs, content extraction and stable seed; no schema negotiation or deterministic-runtime proof.
Finite [0,1] entries and exact shape checked before positive-sum normalization; JSON duplicate keys are not checked before parsing.
Choice tie order, index expectation, noul scalar and inverse-entropy confidence use unrounded floats; helper assumes validated input.
Loopback default, optional client authentication, separate upstream key, health versus models-based readiness.
maxQueue counts unfinished decisions; FIFO semaphore surrounds fetch, not subsequent body parsing; no whole-request deadline or cancellation chain.
Sequential greedy chunks, noul counts one outcome, single question not split; only malformed content retries; no partial result on terminal failure.
Layered errors and upstream-reported usage; eventual failures hide spent partial usage; no monetary cost ledger and external retries can amplify work.
Five Engine, four server and ten eval test cases are read, not executed; mocks do not prove runtime or probability quality.
Default matrix, fixed source checksums, balanced deterministic sampling, interleaved tasks, and full target with 2048 background words.
Five exact model IDs, hardware/runtime and cache policy are author artifacts, not independently verified weights or effective settings.
Failure-aware accuracy versus valid-only probability metrics; linear quantiles, full-decision timing and both-valid pairing, not TTFT.
Ten reported result cells, 1200 requests over 120 IDs, and E2B long-input 3 failures; no raw-row recomputation.
Small differences, quantization/runtime confounders and artificial context do not support isolated architecture rankings.
Dirty run commit differs; all seven run-code/lock and two report-code hashes match fixed bytes.
Missing model refusal, bounded consecutive failure stop, resume hash checks, writer lock and duplicate result rejection.
LocalJev MIT attribution is distinct from model/data rights; dataset cards have different or missing terms.
Transfer narrow typed judgments into code-controlled workflows; calibrate and test separately before consequential use.

metadata_checks.not_recomputed: No raw results.jsonl, data bytes, inference, or upstream report code executed.

limitations: Runtime, inference, SDK interoperability, calibration and service deployment are unverified.
Source byte identity and metadata arithmetic do not prove author measurements authentic or reproducible.
Model/quantization/tokenizer file revisions and full effective runner settings are not pinned.
Raw results/warmups and dataset bytes were not retrieved; no independent request-row aggregation.
Website/issue/PR observations are mutable snapshots dated 2026-09-27; no release-package support verification.
Existing repository baseline and navigation remain unchanged.
